title: Correction case template — replace before collecting evidence

steps.title: Build the first draft
steps.message: Draft a feasible schedule as Plan A using my profile. Include the required course and lab, preserve my protected courses, respect credits and work hours. Do not save or register anything.

steps.title: Add a restriction
steps.message: I also cannot attend Monday classes before 10:00. Keep my existing Tuesday and Thursday work restrictions and all the original requirements. Revise draft Plan A and explain the change.
